name: kb_3d_tensor_matmul_broadcast
description: 3D tensor-matrix multiplication with broadcasting. Input A is a 3D tensor of shape (N, M, K), B is a 2D matrix of shape (K, L). The operation computes matmul for each of the N slices: output[i] = A[i] @ B, resulting in shape (N, M, L). This is commonly used in batched transformations where the same transformation matrix is applied to multiple batches.

N.description: Batch dimension (number of 2D matrices in A)

M.description: Number of rows in each matrix slice of A

K.description: Inner dimension (columns of A slices, rows of B)
